title: Dual circuit
statement: For a directed acyclic circuit on $n$ input vertices, its dual circuit has the same output vertex and the same topological order of gates, with each gate replaced by its dual. The circuit remains acyclic, and its output is a vertex among the $n$ inputs and gates.
hypotheses_covered: the circuit is a DAGCircuit on $n$ inputs, so each gate reads only earlier vertices and the output is a circuit vertex
